Inside the complex

Four signature slides

Open a bay to read the ride and see what it looks like from inside the tube. Hover, tap, or use the arrow keys.

01

Open +

Dueling RocketBLAST® Water Coaster

Launch side-by-side at high speed before racing through exciting turns and uphill climbs. Designed for friendly competition, Dueling Desperados keeps riders neck-and-neck from start to finish.

In the wall · SuperClear tube sections

02

Open +

FlyingSAUCER® 20 · three features

Experience the sensation of dropping and diving as your raft sweeps high across three FlyingSAUCER® features. Fast transitions, soaring turns, and moments of weightlessness create an exhilarating ride.

In the wall · Translucent cowboy boots & light speed rings

03

Open +

Texas' 1st HIVE® 20

HIVE® 20

Twist and turn through a series of open-air helix curves designed for speed and excitement. Panoramic views in every HIVE® make the ride feel fast, immersive, and unforgettable.

In the wall · Translucent galloping horses

04

Open +

TORNADO® 18 / TornadoWAVE® 12

Sharp twists, fast oscillations, and quick-changing directions create a dynamic ride of shared thrills. Riders sweep across towering walls together, creating excitement at every turn.

In the wall · Translucent wagon wheels

The lights are
in the wall

ProSlide ProLucent sets translucent shapes into the slide itself. You do not pass them — you ride straight through them, lit from behind by Texas daylight.

    Dueling Desperados

Five effects across the four rides. Ride Outrider Rush and you get two of them in a single run.
